name: IA-82 Artillery Droid
description: The IA-82 Artillery Droid was a model of six-legged battle droid available during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. The IA-82 generated massive ion blasts from its forward cannon, leaving ion fields in the wake of the blast. The Twi'lek arms dealer Olok the Shadow sold IA-82 Artillery Droids in his auction on Darvannis.
